name: lobby
eval: JSON.stringify({title: document.title, buttons: [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,20), hiddenMenu: document.getElementById('menu')?.hidden, canvas: !!document.querySelector('canvas'), settingsPanel: !!document.querySelector('.settings-search')})

name: open settings
eval: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/settings/i.test(b.textContent)); if(!b) return 'no settings button'; b.click(); return 'clicked '+b.textContent.trim();})()

name: settings state
eval: JSON.stringify({tabs:[...document.querySelectorAll('.tabs [role=tab]')].map(t=>t.textContent.trim()), rows: document.querySelectorAll('.tab-body label, .tab-body .row, .tab-body input, .tab-body select').length, search: !!document.querySelector('.settings-search')})

name: search night
eval: (()=>{const i=document.querySelector('.settings-search'); i.value='night'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return document.querySelectorAll('.tab-body [data-tab]').length+' hits: '+[...document.querySelectorAll('.tab-body [data-tab]')].map(r=>r.textContent.trim().slice(0,40)).join(' | ');})()

name: clear + keybinds tab
eval: (()=>{const i=document.querySelector('.settings-search'); i.value=''; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tabs [role=tab]')].find(t=>/keybind/i.test(t.textContent)); t?.click(); return t? 'keybinds rows '+document.querySelectorAll('.tab-body button').length : 'no keybinds tab';})()
